evidence.title: Beyond Point Predictions: Uncertainty-Aware Satellite Poverty Mapping for Public Policy

summary: Researchers developed an AI model that improves satellite-based poverty mapping by incorporating uncertainty estimates, aiding more reliable public policy decisions. The approach moves beyond traditional point predictions to provide a nuanced understanding of socioeconomic disparities.
title: AI Enhances Satellite Poverty Mapping with Uncertainty-Aware Predictions for Public Policy
